title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Benefits: Tier Reduction on Free Night Awards Returned After a Late Cancellation
content:
Elite tier lowers the protected rebooking price stated on the return record of one of the Free Night Awards returned from a later night of a reservation cancelled after its deadline. The tier reduction is the upper return tier reduction for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member, the lower return tier reduction for a Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member, and nothing for every other member. It is taken off the protected rebooking price once.

| Tier currently held on the Ashbury Rewards membership | Tier reduction |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 5000 points (upper return tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 5000 points (upper return tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 2500 points (lower return tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 2500 points (lower return tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | No tier reduction |
| Ashbury Rewards Member | No tier reduction |

The tier is the elite tier the membership record shows as currently held.
